prompt:
I'm the narrative development lead on a psychological drama series called 'The Tribunal.' We have two lead characters — Dr. Elena Reyes and Marco Vitelli — whose backstories are in the project/characters/backstory/ directory. Our writing team is struggling to keep these characters psychologically consistent across 8 episodes, and our editor keeps saying the relationship between them feels 'unexplained.'

We've brought you on as our psychological consultant. We need you to produce a single document called character_psychology_brief.md that covers: (1) a thorough psychological profile for each character, (2) a rigorous analysis of their relationship dynamic — specifically why these two people are drawn together and what makes their dynamic combust — and (3) everything must be grounded in actual psychological science so our writers can push back intelligently when something feels wrong for the story.

The director's specific notes: don't flatten them into diagnoses; explain WHY Marco keeps entering relationships when partners are in crisis and then pulling away once they stabilize; explain Elena's 'going cold' response as something more specific than 'she shuts down'; and make sure both characters have genuine strengths, not just pathologies. All three pieces of documentation should be in a single file: character_psychology_brief.md
